blocks.text: 据 The Information 周四报道，英伟达正在洽谈为 AI 云服务商 Nscale 在弗吉尼亚州规划的 Anthropic 数据中心提供数十亿美元的债务融资担保。彭博社随后证实了这一报道。根据 Nscale 的 IPO 文件，仅该项目的第一栋建筑，Anthropic 就签下了 446 亿美元的合同。本质上，这家芯片厂商是在为客户的贷款共同签字，这折射出在投资者对涉及的资金规模日益不安之际，AI 行业为维持其建设计划有多拼。

blocks.text: 这一拟议安排将帮助 Nscale 为其弗吉尼亚州园区的电力和建设成本获得融资。据 The Information 报道，在所谓的剩余价值担保机制下，如果 Nscale 拖欠建设款项，英伟达将介入，暂时接管该设施，并协助寻找买家和新的租户。

blocks.text: Nscale 的项目推进一直不顺。截至 8 月，该公司仅有约 2.5 万块先进 AI 芯片在运行，与其计划部署的近 50 万块相比只是零头。其弗吉尼亚州园区本身也麻烦不断。施工现场的径流不止一次淹了附近的住宅。今年 9 月，经过数月谈判，该项目终于获得州政府认证。

blocks.text: 这些讨论出现之际，Anthropic 正面临外界质疑：它将如何为自己的快速扩张提供资金。该公司本周提交了上市申请，但 Blackstone 已提醒投资者，Anthropic 在 IPO 后可能获得低于投资级的信用评级。垃圾级评级会推高 Anthropic 的借贷成本，并可能迫使它继续依赖实力更强的合作伙伴为其债务提供支持。

blocks.text: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions in debt financing for AI cloud provider Nscale’s planned Anthropic data center in West Virginia, The Information reported Thursday. Bloomberg later corroborated the report. Anthropic has signed a $44.6 billion contract for the project’s first building alone, according to Nscale’s IPO filing. In essence, the chipmaker would be co-signing a customer’s loans, a sign of how hard the AI industry is working to keep its buildout plans afloat as investors grow jittery about the amounts of money involved.

blocks.text: The proposed arrangement would help Nscale secure financing for the electricity and construction costs of its West Virginia campus. Under what’s known as a residual value guarantee, Nvidia would step in if Nscale defaulted on construction payments, temporarily take over the facility, and help find a buyer and new tenant, according to The Information.

blocks.text: Nvidia’s earlier support for cloud providers has mostly covered leases and chip purchases, not construction.

blocks.text: The stakes are high for Nscale, which is seeking to go public at a valuation of up to $35 billion despite growing concerns about its ability to deliver on ambitious data center projects.

blocks.text: Anthropic’s contract with Nscale covers the first 460-megawatt building at Nscale’s West Virginia campus, which is expected to use Nvidia’s next-generation Vera Rubin chips. The companies are also discussing a second deal worth roughly $45 billion for another building.

blocks.text: Nscale has struggled to get its projects off the ground. The company had about 25,000 advanced AI chips running in August, a fraction of the nearly 500,000 it plans to deploy. Its West Virginia campus has run into trouble of its own. Runoff from the construction site has flooded nearby homes more than once. In September, after months of negotiations, the project won state certification.

blocks.text: The proposed guarantee would deepen Nvidia’s financial ties to Nscale while helping secure a major customer for its chips. Anthropic, one of the largest buyers of AI computing power, has spread its infrastructure spending across multiple chipmakers. One investor told The Information that Anthropic’s involvement likely explains Nvidia’s interest in keeping Nscale’s project on track.

blocks.text: The discussions also come as Anthropic faces questions about how it will finance its own rapid expansion. The company filed to go public this week, but Blackstone has warned investors that Anthropic may receive a below-investment-grade credit rating after its IPO. A junk rating would raise Anthropic’s borrowing costs and could push it to keep relying on stronger partners to back its debt.
